plain_language: Today's predictions cover signed AI files, defense AI deals, and a US cyber rule. Monday news lands each at top coherence.
findings:
Monday's open consolidates a Sunday-evening Pacific catalyst stack into a coordinated mid-week landing across every standing-prediction lane and seeds the day's three fresh predictions on the same anchored evidence. On the agentic-AI security axis, LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) lands Monday-morning Pacific as a LangGraph checkpoint-deserialization vulnerability matching the Sunday AutoGen pattern, with LangChain shipping LangGraph v0.7.2 same-day plus a backport advisory for the v0.5.x and v0.6.x branches the NHS England blocklist references; Trail of Bits publishes a Monday extended write-up taxonomizing the full seven-CVE agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader wave that landed across May 5-11 (CrewAI, Haystack, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, plus the Friday LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 and LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188), proposing a signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist-validation common-mitigation pattern enforced at the framework boundary; and DeepMind, Meta AI, and Anthropic co-publish a Monday joint preprint (arxiv 2605.06342) proposing a common signed-checkpoint format with reference implementations in Python and Rust plus formal compositional safety proofs covering the seven CVE pattern instances, paired with parallel Microsoft, LangChain, and CrewAI maintainer commitments to ship as default in the next minor-version release on a coordinated mid-June target window.

On the policy axis, the FMRB executive-order interagency-review track opens Monday with a sharpened May 15 14:00 EDT S-407 classified threshold briefing witness slate — Senator Mark Warner's office confirms the CISA Director joining the previously-confirmed NIST Director Locascio, ODNI cyber lead, NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director, and Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center representative as the fifth witness, focusing the operational view on federal-civilian-executive-branch agentic-AI deployment exposure. ACLU and the Center for Democracy and Technology file a joint Monday amicus letter joining the AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge, Lawyers for Civil Justice, Knight First Amendment Institute, and EFF coalition pressing the documented State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument plus a 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window; OSTP holds its line that the draft remains in interagency review with no signing window before May 22, leaving CISA as the operative federal-civilian enforcement vehicle as the May 21 n8n federal-civilian remediation deadline lands first. The Indo-Pacific cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter reaches its first ten-jurisdiction Monday count with Indonesia BSSN/Kominfo entering as a formal observer on a 150-day domestic-consultation window targeting Q4 2026 mirror signature and Vietnam MIC confirming observer entry under Track II shoulder-to-shoulder arrangements parallel to the Sunday Taiwan NICS announcement.

In the agentic-platform layer, Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 day-four registry telemetry shows a Monday consolidation: 19,800 published skills (up from 17,200 Sunday, +15.1 percent — first sub-20-percent daily gain since launch), 1.92M skill installs across the fourth 24 hours (a 32 percent acceleration), and 36 auto-quarantined Mythos-class skills (up from 29 Sunday). Israel's Check Point Software Technologies, Italy's Leonardo SpA, and Sweden's Saab AB sign the contractual ethics-and-misuse rider on the Monday business open, lifting the gated cohort to 48 enterprise customers; Simon Willison's Monday note documents that the per-tenant attestation-log audit-trail review reproduces deterministically across the 48 gated tenants using the open-source verification harness shipped Saturday, completing the Verifiable Per-Tenant Capability Attestation paper's lived demonstration cycle. Mistral AI Workflows day-eleven lands the United Kingdom's HM Revenue and Customs as the third central-government sovereign-cloud reference inside 72 hours after France DGFiP and Germany Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit, with paid tenancy crossing 318 enterprise customers and daily-execution count past 5.1M; the Workflows-Codestral cross-orchestrator interop adds Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog to complete the three-vendor matrix with the OpenAI Codex CLI Plan-Apply export format and the Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry signed-export format. The three-hyperscaler agent-registry interop matrix completes its Monday consolidation: AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise interop moves to FedRAMP-Moderate general availability two months ahead of the previously-communicated Q3 GA window, Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center adds a Monday changelog covering the signed-skill provenance verification flow for the Mistral Workflows signed-export format, and Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog adds the Israel National Cyber Directorate plus Italy's National Cybersecurity Agency cyber-eval reciprocity attestation fields.

On the formal-verification axis, End-to-End Sovereign-Cloud Composition Verification for Agentic AI (arxiv 2605.06298) layers on top of the May 10 Multi-Tenant MCP Tool-Call Graph Verification paper a sovereign-cloud-jurisdiction composition framework providing formal verification of jurisdiction-boundary-crossing capability gating with the EU AI Act Section 51, UK AISI, Singapore IMDA, Japan AISI, South Korea PIPC, and New Zealand GCSB reciprocity-attestation field schemas as named verifiable constraints, co-authored by MIT CSAIL, ETH Zurich, Anthropic, Microsoft, and the EU AI Office. On capital markets, Cerebras CBRS opens its second trading week +9.5 percent at $189.40 validating Morgan Stanley's $192 raise and Jefferies' $178 initiation without testing Bernstein's $172 Market-Perform floor (Bernstein moves the single-counterparty-concentration risk to a more prominent placement but holds the rating); Tenstorrent files its confidential S-1 final pre-submission cover note (JPMorgan/Morgan Stanley/Citi joint leads, Mizuho and SMBC Nikko co-managers reflecting Hyundai Motor Group and Samsung Foundry co-anchor positions) opening the JOBS Act EGC filing window today; SambaNova confirms Wells Fargo Securities as joint lead on an unchanged late-June timeline; AMD Helios plus MI450 commitments cross 8.0GW with a 0.6GW SoftBank Sakai expansion plus a 0.4GW NTT Data sovereign-cloud Asia-Pacific commitment. On local-LLM tooling, Unsloth's Monday changelog adds a tensor-parallel mode for the router-attention forward pass on dual-Hopper workstation tiers delivering a further 17 percent peak-VRAM reduction and 28 percent forward-pass latency improvement, plus an extended ONNX INT4 export path; vLLM v0.11.2 ships a parallel tensor-parallel disaggregated-prefill mode narrowing the vLLM-versus-SGLang RadixArk throughput gap to 11.3 percent (from 16.7 percent Sunday); and Cloudflare Infire reports the L40S edge-tier Infire advantage narrows to 1.25x. Tesla Optimus Gen 3 reaches 24 active units at Fremont (cycle-time tightens to 1.15x human-baseline) with a first multi-station three-station hand-off chain video; Boston Dynamics Atlas reports a 4.1 percent cycle-time improvement on the Hyundai Steel Dangjin rolling-mill pickup task from the first Tenstorrent-Galaxy-rack LoRA fine-tune cycle.
relation_to_my_preds:
On the agent-framework signed-checkpoint and manifest mode prediction (May 11), today's evidence is the catalyst stack itself collapsing the Q4 2026 framework-default landing toward a coordinated mid-June target inside a single Monday cycle. The LangChain CVE-2026-44712 disclosure completes the seven-CVE agent-loader wave the prediction names as the structural force; the Trail of Bits Monday taxonomy explicitly proposes the signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist-validation common-mitigation pattern the prediction names as the most likely shape; and the DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic joint preprint (arxiv 2605.06342) with reference implementations in Python and Rust plus formal compositional safety proofs, paired with parallel Microsoft, LangChain, and CrewAI maintainer Monday commitments to ship the format and schema as default in the next minor-version release on a coordinated mid-June target window, are exactly the documented-default-loader-mode forcing-function inputs the prediction names. The bear case (a framework forking the loader contract and refusing the signature-verification default in favor of a sandbox-only mitigation) does not show up in Monday's evidence — every named cohort member commits to the common format.

On the capability-attestation rider default-MSA prediction (May 11), Monday lands the formal-verification substrate plus the second consecutive weekend-then-Monday cohort expansion that the prediction names as the procedural floor. Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 day-four telemetry adds Israel's Check Point, Italy's Leonardo, and Sweden's Saab to the gated cohort (now 48 tenants spanning the US-defense-industrial cohort, the European NATO-allied defense-prime tier from Sunday, and the new Israel-Italy-Sweden additions); Simon Willison's Monday note documents the per-tenant attestation-log audit-trail review reproduces deterministically across all 48 gated tenants using the open-source verification harness, completing the lived demonstration cycle the prediction names as the audit-trail-repeatability anchor; and arxiv 2605.06298 layers a sovereign-cloud-jurisdiction composition framework on top of the Sunday multi-tenant theorem with six allied reciprocity-attestation field schemas as named verifiable constraints, co-authored by MIT CSAIL, ETH Zurich, Anthropic, Microsoft, and the EU AI Office — giving corporate counsel exactly the citable safety theorem the prediction names as the MSA-negotiation-hardening forcing function. The Big-4-firm template move and the GAO plus CCS plus EU procurement reference adoption remain the open bear case; the hyperscaler-mediated equivalent shape that the bear case names also does not show up Monday.

On the CISA agentic-AI CVE plus capability-attestation pairing prediction (May 11), Monday lands the operative-enforcement-vehicle sharpening the prediction names as the structural force inside a single news cycle. The May 15 S-407 classified threshold briefing witness slate firms to five with the CISA Director joining NIST Director Locascio, ODNI cyber lead, NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director, and Microsoft MSTIC — carrying the operational view of Mythos-class capability exposure on enterprise tenants directly into the executive-order interagency-review conversation as the prediction names. LangChain CVE-2026-44712 completes the seven-CVE agent-loader wave the prediction names as the converging-CVE-cluster trigger; Shadowserver day-eleven exposed-instance count falls to approximately 4,920 with residual unpatched share at 33 percent while Censys honeypot exploitation attempts spike to 6.4x baseline at the Monday 09:00 UTC mark — consistent with the Sunday-evening Aikido warning of commodity-tier operators awaiting the Monday open. OSTP's Monday confirmation that no FMRB EO signing window opens before May 22 holds the May 21 federal-civilian n8n remediation deadline as the first-arriving lever, leaving CISA as the operative federal-civilian enforcement vehicle in exactly the gap the prediction names. The bear case (the FMRB executive order shipping first with the agentic-AI workflow scope pre-empted) is held off another Monday cycle. The remaining gap is that no Binding Operational Directive draft text or Federal Register notice publishes today — the operative-enforcement-vehicle position sharpens but the named pairing of CVE remediation with per-tenant Mythos attestation has not yet been instrumented in a published BOD.
